nodes.text: @RubikaLiyaquat Misinformation post. HMPV is a common virus and has been around in India and everywhere else forever. It causes common cold like illness and generally anyone ill recovered easily without any medication, in cases over the counter cold medicines are helpful. Nothing to panic about.
